data.narrative:
Still Bright, a Seed-stage climate and energy company founded by Jon Vardner and Professors Alan C. West and Scott Banta, has raised $18.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine Climate & Energy firms (one public: LNZA; eight private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix), though the private peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables for reliable median-based triangulation.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage transitions, using the $18.7M raised as a valuation proxy. This yields an implied valuation of $47M. A Peer-Median approach was not applicable; while eight Climate & Energy peers exist in the broader dataset, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints, making such a median unreliable.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to the single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $40M to $54M, with a median of $47M. Key uncertainties include the lack of granular same-stage peer data for this frontier-tech subsector and reliance on a standardized multiplier that may not capture Still Bright's specific technology maturity or market position. The range should be treated as directional pending additional comparable transactions or disclosure of recent investor valuations.
